pretreatments.description: A Hollander beater mechanical pretreatment using a modified Hollander beater model (Reina) equipped with an elliptic water raceway and a bladed drum rotating at 580 RPM. The process involves a bed-plate with sharp grooves located under the rotating wheel that exercises a cutting action while high pressure and speed reach under the drum beat the mixture. The blades and grooves reduce particle sizes and increase specific surface area available for microorganisms, facilitating digestion.
